notes.cam_code: integer code for camera_id, fit on sorted train cameras; all 300 test cameras have train history
notes.latlon_fill: NaN lat/lon imputed with train medians (41.9097, -87.6998)
notes.depth_limit: First run used unbounded trees: RMSE 3.3116, MAE 2.1641, but the file was 2.9 GB (150 trees x ~266k nodes). A max_depth=12 retrain scored slightly BETTER on the same holdout (RMSE 3.3068, MAE 2.1452) at 56 MB, so it is the shipped v1. The unbounded model is kept as redunator_brain_v1_rf_unbounded.joblib.
notes.xgboost_compact: XGBoost retrained identically and saved as redunator_brain_v1_xgboost.joblib (8.3 MB, RMSE 3.3613, MAE 2.1477).
